what: Post-rename grep expects exactly three hits of zero_findings_padded_attest_rejected but only two source sites contain that string (case label and AGGREGATE_STUB_MERGE_KIND); the echo title rename does not include the kind name
scenario_or_breakage: Implementer follows the stated verification and treats a correct two-hit grep as a missed rename site, causing unnecessary rework or a spurious fourth edit somewhere
suggested_fix: Change the check to expect two grep hits for the kind string (or grep separately for the rejection echo substring); keep the three-edit list but do not conflate it with three kind-name matches
